reasoning_traces.think:
The core operator is the Bradley-Terry model extended with covariates and regularization. It maps game outcomes into team utilities, enabling probabilistic win predictions. The system assumes that team strength can be modeled as a latent variable with additive effects from covariates such as home field advantage and rest differential. This formulation allows for dynamic updates during the season and supports player-aware adjustments. Conformal prediction (EnbPI) provides valid uncertainty bounds around these predictions, ensuring that confidence intervals reflect true variability rather than overfitting. The calibration layer then filters out unreliable predictions based on interval width or dropout variance, improving decision quality. These components form a coherent pipeline where each step builds upon the previous one, with feedback loops ensuring robustness against data drift and model instability.
